high_level_description: The image shows a box of the Oculus Quest 2 VR headset placed on a bed with a quilted green cover. The background is a plain wall, and there appears to be a black object, possibly a speaker or a lamp, partially visible behind the box. The text at the top of the image reads: "Q: Look who's home? A: someone who at times can take you out of your home without you having to go out 😌" The box itself is white with the Oculus logo prominently displayed at the top left corner. The words "Oculus" and "Quest 2" are written in bold letters.
